depicted_variant: Varian humanoid raksasa berhati es, mengancam penonton dalam dingin musim dingin, tanpa tanduk popculture.

visual_requirements.description: Humanoid raksasa satu kepala2mata2lengan2kaki; tanpa deerhead/tanduk; berpakaian penuh.
Dingin dan hati es tanpa glow; ancaman/taunting dalam mulut terbuka.
Utara musim dingin berhubungan kelaparan; hutan dingin editorial.

aura: Gigantisme wendigo-c09, dingin hati es wendigo-c04 serta ancaman bicara wendigo-c12 menegaskan bahaya tanpa deerhorns.
artistic_choices: Varian humanoid c04/c09 dipilih; tidak menggabungkan emaciated/horns c35 atau film c31.
Hati es tidak diekspos atau dibuat bercahaya, dingin hadir lewat frost dan napas biasa.
Pakaian penuh lusuh warna walnut, pohon kecil pembanding ukuran giants, bukan manusia korban; no cannibalism/gore.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of WENDIGO, the giant humanoid with an ice heart in Algonquian winter lore.
ANATOMY: ONE giant HUMANLIKE head,TWO eyes,TWO arms and TWO legs,many times human height; NO deer head,NO antlers,horns,wings,skull mask or exposed glowing heart. Fully clothed in opaque tattered dark winter tunic and trousers,the chest and pelvis completely covered. Harsh cold humanlike face,not a normal passerby. [wendigo-c04,wendigo-c09]
MOMENT: striding over snowbanks toward us,one long hand reaching threateningly,face bent downward with mouth open in a cruel taunt; small fir trees at its knees.
POWER: chill associated with its ice heart manifests as heavy natural frost on cloth and coarse fingers,cold breath only; ability to threaten in speech,NO magic beam,fire or aura. [wendigo-c04,wendigo-c12]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low snow-level angle,towering humanoid fills frame,small northern trees give giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one pale winter moon,deeper walnut-black shadows,dense falling snow whipped by ordinary wind.
SURFACE: frost-crusted opaque rough cloth,weathered cold skin,icy snow.
SETTING: northern winter,cold and famine association; snowy forest is editorial staging. [wendigo-c08]
MOOD: predatory frightening giant,never ordinary man,cute/calm/decorative;NO victim eating or cultural ritual.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, exposed breasts or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native dan200px dilihat: satu kepala humanoid2mata2lengan/tangan5digit2kaki,raksasa dibanding trees,sepenuhnya opaque cloth. Langkah mendominasi/reaching dan taunting face c12, frost/chill c04/winter c08,7Uji Sangar semua ya. Tanpa antlers/deerhead/glowingheart/korban/gore/teks/glyph/desainadaptasi.

root_visual_review.notes: Gaunt snow-caked giant with open mouth reaching down at the viewer in a winter forest blizzard; no deer head or antlers, clothed in ragged hides.
